text: 2026-08-03 fixed-weighting evidence: VolumeWeighting.Fixed now applies sqrt(w) to both design rows and response rows at selected full-model timepoint indices, rejects zero/negative/non-finite weights with typed errors, and records the policy receipt. Added chunked-vs-unchunked OLS equivalence coverage; focused fit suites pass 59/59 on JVM and 59/59 on Scala.js. Estimated weighting remains explicitly unsupported until an estimator/source contract exists; LSS fixed weighting remains an explicit boundary.
